beat: Saturday Raj–Sharmi home: welcome, new dress, greetings and split sofa seating

lines.original: Ding Dong:
lines.local: Ding dong!

lines.original: They heard a tiny foot running towards the door...
lines.local: Darwaze ki taraf nanhe pair daudte hue sunaayi diye.

lines.original: Sharmi: hey...... my favorite couples... come come.. she hugged both John and Dhika... and she pinched little Pappu's cheeks....
lines.local: Sharmi: Hey, mere favorite couple! Aao-aao. Usne John aur Dhika dono ko hug kiya aur chhote Pappu ke gaal halke se kheenche.

lines.original: Sharmi: looking fully at Dhika's new dress.... oohhhhh....what a surprise..... Dhika in modern dress.... is it specially for me?........or my husband perhaps!...she teased
lines.local: Dhika ki nayi dress achchhe se dekhkar Sharmi: Ooh, kya surprise! Dhika modern dress mein! Mere liye khaas pehni hai ya mere husband ke liye? Woh chhed rahi thi.

lines.original: Dhika: aii..... I just thought I would prove someone wrong... she gave a childish angry look at John.
lines.local: Dhika John ko bachchon jaisi naaraazgi se dekhte hue: Bas kisi ko galat saabit karna tha.

lines.original: Pappu was in sleep mode as car travel always makes him sleepy...
lines.local: Gaadi mein Pappu ko hamesha neend aa jaati thi; ab woh neend mein tha.

lines.original: Sharmi welcomed them in and took them to the hall......
lines.local: Sharmi sabko andar hall mein le aayi.

lines.original: They just entered the hall... when they heard foot steps fromt the top floor of the house....
lines.local: Hall mein pahunchte hi upar se kadmon ki aahat aayi.

lines.original: Sharmi: smiling... Raj is coming.... and she noticed Pappu slept already....
lines.local: Sharmi: Raj aa raha hai. Usne dekha Pappu so chuka hai.

lines.original: She offered to put Pappu in one of their guest bedrooms on the ground floor. Saying, she took John to it....
lines.local: Usne guest room mein Pappu ko sulane ki offer di aur John ko ground floor ke ek guest bedroom tak le gayi.

lines.original: While Dhika was alone waiting in the hall... the foot steps became louder and she looked Raj coming down... Raj was dressed in casual cargo pants and white lenin shirt.......
lines.local: Dhika akeli hall mein wait kar rahi thi; kadam tez sunaayi diye toh dekha Raj neeche aa raha hai. Usne casual cargo pants aur safed linen shirt pehni thi.

lines.original: Raj: Hey Dhika, she shouted... almost down now... welcome welcome...... nice of you .... X
lines.local: Raj: Hey Dhika! Woh kareeb neeche aate hue bola. Welcome, welcome, achchha hua tum... [RAW ka antim 'X' aspasht hai.]

lines.original: He stop talking...... and his rapid foot steps turned into a turtle motion, looking at her dress.....
lines.local: Woh bolte-bolte ruk gaya; Dhika ki dress dekhte hi tez kadam kachhue ki chaal mein badal gaye.

lines.original: Dhika saw what happened and blushed a little.... and the same time Sharmi too came back holding John in her arms..... they saw Raj mesmerized looking at Dhika's dress and Sharmi and John started laughing.....
lines.local: Dhika ne yeh notice karke halka blush kiya. Usi waqt Sharmi John ki baah thaame laut aayi. Raj ko uski dress mein khoya dekh Sharmi aur John hans pade.

lines.original: Raj: hehe... welcome John.... Dhika.... you look beautiful, I must say......
lines.local: Raj: Hehe, welcome John... Dhika, sach mein bahut beautiful lag rahi ho.

lines.original: Dhika was dressed in a gorgeous white sleeveless shift dress, that huggged around her body and ran until a few inches above the knees.... her hair was curling around her shoulders and she wore a dark rose lipstick....
lines.local: Dhika ne ek beautiful safed sleeveless shift dress pehni thi jo badan se fit thi aur ghutnon se kuch inch upar tak aati thi; baal kandhon tak curl ho rahe the aur dark-rose lipstick lagayi thi.

lines.original: Dhika: Blushing... thank you Raj....
lines.local: Dhika sharmaakar: Thank you Raj.

lines.original: Raj: sorry.... its just that I have never seen you.... like this...
lines.local: Raj: Sorry... maine tumhe is tarah kabhi nahi dekha na.

lines.original: John: you and I both brother... he teased Dhika.
lines.local: John Dhika ko chhedte hue: Haan bhai, main bhi!

lines.original: Dhika: oi... you have seen.. she blushed..
lines.local: Dhika: Oi, tumne toh dekha hai! Woh blush hui.

lines.original: John: putting his tongue out... not outside the house... hehe
lines.local: John jeebh nikaalkar: Ghar ke bahar nahi. Hehe.

lines.original: All started laughing and moved to settle down in the sofa... Raj politely escorted Dhika to the sofa area....
lines.local: Sab hans pade aur sofa ki taraf chal diye. Raj politely Dhika ko sofa tak escort karne laga.

lines.original: Sharmi was dressed in a similar fashion except hers were with tiny straps for shoulders and contracts to Dhika's.... it was pure black... ... it looked hot like a satin night dress.
lines.local: Sharmi ki dress bhi similar thi, par shoulder straps bahut patli thi; Dhika ke safed dress ke contrast mein pure black, satin-nightdress jaisi lag rahi thi.

lines.original: Still standing, holding John's arm... Sharmi walked him hand in hand and they both settled in a 2 seater sofa.... sharmi still not leaving his hands.
lines.local: Sharmi abhi bhi John ki baah thaame use apne saath laayi; dono two-seater sofa par baith gaye aur usne uska haath nahi chhoda.

lines.original: They had two 2 seater sofas and a single seater sofa.... Dhika was hoping to sit with John, but seeing naughty Sharmi taking her place... she took the single sofa and Raj took the 2 seater next to hers....
lines.local: Hall mein do two-seater aur ek single-seater sofa the. Dhika John ke saath baithna chahti thi, lekin Sharmi ne uski jagah le li, toh woh single seat par baithi; Raj bagal wale two-seater par baitha.
